# Comprehensive Review Gate Checklist: Consolidate Frontend UI Assets into Gateway

**Purpose**: Comprehensive requirements-quality review gate covering migration completeness, static delivery contracts, documentation alignment, and build/packaging integrity  
**Created**: 2026-09-18  
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///Users/lazolazarev/projects/springboot_rube_goldberg/specs/019-consolidate-ui-assets/spec.md) | [plan.md](file:///Users/lazolazarev/projects/springboot_rube_goldberg/specs/019-consolidate-ui-assets/plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all six frontend static assets (`customer` and `manager` index.html, app.js, keycloak.js) explicitly enumerated in the asset catalog? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK002 Is the removal of the top-level `ui/` directory specified to include all child directories and git tracking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the specific public URLs for both customer and manager portals documented in the serving contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contracts §2]
- [x] CHK004 Are documentation update requirements scoped to specify which files must be modified versus preserved? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-18]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK005 Is the canonical classpath location (`gateway/src/main/resources/static/ui/`) specified with unambiguous directory paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK006 Are the HTTP response status codes and expected MIME types (`text/html`, `application/javascript`) explicitly defined for all served assets? [Clarity, Contracts §2]
- [x] CHK007 Is the boundary between active living documentation and historical spec artifacts explicitly articulated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK008 Is the requirement for zero Dockerfile/Docker Compose references to `ui/` clearly stated? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Research §1]

## Requirement Consistency & Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK009 Do the requirements maintain consistency between the single canonical location in Gateway and the complete absence of `ui/`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-002]
- [x] CHK010 Is it consistently established that frontend styling, business logic, and Keycloak authentication flows remain unmodified? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Are gateway reverse-proxy routes and public static resource access rules aligned without security conflicts? [Consistency, Contracts §3, Plan §Technical Context]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Does the spec address relative path script resolution (such as `<script src="app.js">`) when assets are served via Gateway? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Does the specification account for public unauthenticated access to `/ui/**` versus authenticated backend API endpoints? [Coverage, Contracts §3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are edge case requirements defined for potential 404 handling if non-existent static paths are requested? [Coverage, Contracts §2.7, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-006]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for validating bit-for-bit file parity prior to deletion to prevent accidental asset loss? [Coverage, Research §1, Quickstart §1]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK016 Can the requirement of zero duplicate files in the repository be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Is the 100% HTTP 200 availability criterion testable via automated HTTP/curl checks? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §5]
- [x] CHK018 Is the absence of deprecated `ui/src/` references in `README.md` verifiable via string inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Quickstart §6]
- [x] CHK019 Is the requirement for 100% reactor test pass rate objectively verifiable with standard Maven commands? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Constitution §V]

## Non-Functional & Packaging Validation

- [x] CHK020 Are container packaging requirements defined for Jib to verify static assets exist in the gateway image? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Quickstart §4]
- [x] CHK021 Is performance expectation for static asset delivery quantified with measurable latency thresholds? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Contracts §4, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK022 Are governance constraints from the project constitution (strict `./mvnw` usage, multi-module integrity) incorporated? [Consistency, Constitution §II, §V, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
